body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). The scripts/test ceremony, store, audit, and mirror test suites (ceremony-drift-exit.test.mjs, release-audit-collect.test.mjs, store-loader-bounded.test.mjs, sync-herdr-mirror.test.mjs) manually invoke mkdtempSync across 26 sites (many uncleaned leaks) or manage removals via try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In scripts/test/ceremony-drift-exit.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update makeRepo(t, { drift }) to accept t and allocate dir via tmp(t, 'adlc-drift-repo-').
   - Update tests to accept t and pass to makeRepo(t, ...).
   - Remove manual try/finally cleanup blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In scripts/test/release-audit-collect.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update fixtureTree(t) to accept t and allocate root via tmp(t, 'release-audit-inv-').
   - Update tests to accept t and pass to fixtureTree(t).
3. In scripts/test/store-loader-bounded.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t from test(...).
   - Replace local tmp() helper calls with tmp(t, 'adlc-store-dos-').
   - Delete the local function tmp() helper.
4. In scripts/test/sync-herdr-mirror.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update fakeRepo(t) to accept t and allocate root via tmp(t, 'adlc-mirror-src-').
   - Update test declarations to accept t.
   - Replace direct mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix).
5. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove ceremony-drift-exit.test.mjs, release-audit-collect.test.mjs, store-loader-bounded.test.mjs, and sync-herdr-mirror.test.mjs from the ALLOWLIST set (completely eradicating scripts/test from allowlist).
6. Verification:
   - node --test scripts/test/ceremony-drift-exit.test.mjs scripts/test/release-audit-collect.test.mjs scripts/test/store-loader-bounded.test.mjs scripts/test/sync-herdr-mirror.test.mjs exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -c 'finally' scripts/test/ceremony-drift-exit.test.mjs returns 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 All 4 test files contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 4 test files.
- AC3 None of the 4 test files appear in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs ALLOWLIST.
- AC4 node --test scripts/test/ceremony-drift-exit.test.mjs scripts/test/release-audit-collect.test.mjs scripts/test/store-loader-bounded.test.mjs scripts/test/sync-herdr-mirror.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(scripts): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit across ceremony, store, audit, and mirror tests
